equipment.extrasNote: The equipment workbench has neither of these: the country’s own name in the catalogue (a localisation text), and a new model based on this one.
equipment.countryNameForOptional: {tag}’s name (shown in the catalogue; left empty, the general name is used)
equipment.notFound: This model is not in the equipment files.
equipment.fileNote: Defined in {file}; the first save takes the whole file into the project, and the export uses the project’s copy from then on.

problem.countryNameKept: The game already has a country name for it: it cannot be emptied, but it can be changed to another name
problem.tokenInvalid: The identifier may only use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, and cannot start with a digit

newModel.created: Created model “{name}”; unlock it in a technology’s research rewards, and it appears in the production catalogue once the country has researched that technology
newModel.heading: New model based on this one (saved in the equipment workbench)
newModel.name: New model’s name

subUnit.notFound: This battalion’s definition is not in the game files.
subUnit.affectsAll: This changes the battalion type itself: every division that uses it changes too.
subUnit.problem: Numbers cannot be empty or negative; equipment counts are whole numbers
subUnit.note: If the project’s battalion workbench has this battalion as its own, that row is changed; otherwise the units file it is in is taken into the project whole, and only this battalion’s numbers are changed.

design.nameTaken: There is already a design called “{name}”: to save as a new design, pick another name.
design.nameTakenVariant: There is already a design called “{name}”: to save as a new design, pick another name, or use “Save changes” to change that design itself.
design.note: A saved design is written into the country’s starting history (create_equipment_variant), so the country has it from the start; the designer’s numbers follow the changes, worked out as the game does.

problem.nameInvalid: The name cannot contain quotes, backslashes or line breaks

deployment.addedImported: Added {name} (first time: the whole file {file} was taken into the project); pick its province in the panel
deployment.added: Added {name}; pick its province in the panel
deployment.title: Starting units
deployment.countsHeading: Divisions per template at the start (including those added below)
deployment.editHint: Edit it here with the deployments workbench’s editor
deployment.note: Written into the project’s starting units (the same table as the deployments workbench) and exported with the country’s order of battle file; the existing units stay as they are.
deployment.pickHint: Click a unit to edit it here with the deployments workbench’s editor.

division.rankNote: Experience sets the rank (one step up at 10% / 30% / 75% / 90%); equipment is the strength bar.
division.problem: The name cannot be empty or contain quotes or braces; experience and equipment are 0 to 100%
division.note: Saving first takes the country’s whole order of battle file into the project (as the division designer does), then changes only this division’s block; a new name is written as a fixed name and is no longer numbered from a division name group.
division.add: Add a division in Recruit & Deploy
division.addHint: New divisions are added in Recruit & Deploy with “Add unit”, where you pick the template, the province and how many.
division.addedElsewhere: This division was added in Recruit & Deploy; change or delete it there.

oob.loading: Loading the project’s order of battle…
oob.shipsInFleet: In {fleet} · {size, plural, one {# ship} other {# ships}}.
oob.problemTaskForce: The name cannot be empty or contain quotes or braces
oob.problemAirWing: The name cannot be empty or contain quotes or braces; the count is a whole number from 1 to 1000
oob.noteTaskForce: If the project’s order of battle workbench already has this file, its row is changed; otherwise the country’s whole order of battle file is taken into the project, and only this task force is changed.
oob.noteAirWing: If the project’s order of battle workbench already has this file, its row is changed; otherwise the country’s whole order of battle file is taken into the project, and only this air wing is changed.
